biggest_catch: Bonus is paid on or before 180 days after account opening — an unusually slow payout; if you close the account within 6 months, TD can claw back the bonus at closing.
catches: Bonus paid on or before 180 days after account opening (slow); account must not be closed or restricted at payout.
If the account is closed by you or TD within 6 months of opening, TD reserves the right to deduct the bonus at closing.
15 qualifying TD Visa debit purchases must POST within 60 calendar days; ATM withdrawals do not qualify; returns/adjustments can disqualify purchases.
New TD personal checking customers only; no prior checking bonus ever; no account closed in preceding 12 months.
Offer may be withdrawn at any time (no stated expiry on the public student offer page).
Bonus may be reported on IRS Form 1099; backup withholding may apply if W-9 information is not provided.
TD Bank employees and Canadian cross-border banking customers not eligible.
